# Temple Scroll Column 60 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 60 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**60:1** Innocent blood must not be shed in the land the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance, or you will bear the guilt of bloodshed.

**60:2** But suppose a man hates his neighbor and deliberately ambushes him, attacks him, and kills him, then runs to one of the cities of refuge —

**60:3** the elders of his own city must send for him, bring him back, and hand him over to the victim's nearest relative for execution.

**60:4** Show him no mercy. You must purge the stain of innocent blood from Israel, and then things will go well for you.

**60:5** Do not move a boundary stone marking the property line your ancestors established in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

**60:6** One witness alone is not enough to convict anyone of a crime or wrongdoing, no matter what the offense. A matter may be established only by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

**60:7** If a witness with malicious intent testifies falsely against someone,

**60:8** both the accuser and the accused must appear before the LORD — that is, before the priests and judges serving at that time.

**60:9** The judges must conduct a thorough investigation, and if they find that the witness has lied and given false testimony against a fellow Israelite,

**60:10** you must impose on the false witness the same penalty he was trying to bring on the other person. In this way you will purge the evil from among you.

**60:11** When the rest of the people hear about it, they will be afraid, and no one among you will ever do such a wicked thing again.

**60:12** Show no mercy in such cases: the penalty shall be life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

**60:13** When you go to war against your enemies and see that they have horses, chariots, and an army larger than yours, do not be afraid. The LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, is with you.

**60:14** Before you go into battle, a priest shall step forward and address the troops.

**60:15** He shall say: Listen, Israel! Today you are about to fight your enemies. Do not be fainthearted. Do not be afraid. Do not panic or tremble before them.

**60:16** For the LORD your God goes with you. He will fight for you against your enemies and give you the victory.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 60 covers Deuteronomy 19:10-20:4. The deliberate murderer (60:2-3) is distinguished from the accidental manslayer of Column 59. "Victim's nearest relative" for go'el ha-dam — explaining the kinship obligation. The false witness law includes the mirror-punishment principle (lex talionis). The priest's battle speech (60:14-16) provides theological assurance before combat, grounded in the Exodus memory.*
